Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle now. Kate Pelle and Sienna Ginger are the two openers for Australia Women Under-19. India Women Under-19 going with spin straightaway as Mannat Kashyap has the new ball in hand. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, India Women Under-19 have posted a well below-par total and will need something extraordinary to defend this. Australia Women Under-19 will be confident enough to chase this low total and get the win. Let's see how the chase unfolds.

Australia Women Under-19 absolutely outplayed India Women Under-19. It all started with Milly Illingworth getting rid of Shafali Verma quite early in the innings. They came up with a plan and sticked to it. Their fielding was top notch as well and except for a couple of dropped catches, everything else was excellent. Sienna Ginger was their pick of the bowlers with three wickets while Milly Illingworth and Maggie Clark picked up a couple eache. Ella Hayward and Rhys McKenna also got one each. Now, it is upto their batters to chase this and start the Super Six with a huge victory.

India Women Under-19 will be really disappointed with their performance with the blade. They just could not get going and were not able to build any sort of partnerships in the middle. Shweta Sehrawat were their top scorer with 21 runs, but she too struggled in the middle. They did not have any answers to the pace attack of the Aussies. Titas Sadhu played a quick-fire knock at the end to take them near the 90-run mark, but they know that this no where near enough.

A dominating bowling display from Australia Women Under-19! They have bowled out probably the best batting order in this competition for just 87 runs. India Women Under-19 will need to erase this innings from their memories and look forward.

OUT! A fitting end to the India Women Under-19 inning as they never really got running! Rhys McKenna bowls this on a good length and outside the off stump. Archana Devi pushes this towards point and sets off for a single. Sonam Yadav is slow to respond as she is struggling to make ground. The pickup and throw from Amy Smith is slightly away from Paris Hall but she does well to reach her right hand out and collect the ball before whipping the bails off. The leg umpire raises his finger and brings an end to a poor batting performance by India Women Under-19.
Goes full and outside off. Sonam Yadav shimmies down the wicket and strokes this towards cover for a quick single.
Sonam Yadav is the last batter in for India Women Under-19.

OUT! CAUGHT! Titas Sadhu's cameo comes to an end! Rhys McKenna bowls this on a good length and into the batter as she looks to make room on the leg side. Titas Sadhu goes through with her shot as she looks to loft this over the infield on the off side but gets cramped for room and ends up lobbing it towards cover-point. Lucy K Hamilton back-track a bit and takes a fine catch with both hands over her head and India Women Under-19 are one wicket away from being bowled out here.
Commentary.Howout: c Lucy K Hamilton b Rhys McKenna

Commentary.Commentary: Short once again and outside off. Titas Sadhu cuts this to deep point and some sloppy fielding allows them to take a couple of runs.
FOUR! Great start to the over! Rhys McKenna bowls this full and outside the off stump. Titas Sadhu strokes this into the gap towards deep cover-point for four runs.
Rhys McKenna to bowl the penultimate over.
Goes back to bowling short and outside off. Titas Sadhu pulls this towards deep square leg for a singe and will keep strike.
FOUR! That has been thumped! Ella Hayward flights this one full and outside off. Titas Sadhu pounds this towards long off and collects four runs.
Bowls this short as well and outside the off stump. Titas Sadhu looks to cut but misses.
This is short and outside the off stump. Archana Devi shuffles across the stumps and tucks this towards mid-wicket for a single.
Archana Devi comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ella Hayward also gets among the wickets and Hrishita Basu's fight is brought to a premature end! A loopy delivery bowled full and outside the off stump. Hrishita Basu looks to power this over the off side but ends up slicing it high towards backward point. Claire Moore moves to her left and takes an easy catch and India Women Under-19 lose their eighth wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Claire Moore b Ella Hayward

Commentary.Commentary: Ella Hayward flights this one full and outside off. Hrishita Basu looks to slog sweep this but mistimes it towards mid-wicket.
Goes full and in line with the stumps. Hrishita Basu looks to paddle this fine and lobs it towards fine leg for a single.

FOUR! This a much-needed boundary for India Women Under-19 and this has been beautifully executed! Sienna Ginger bowls this slightly short and outside off. Hrishita Basu pulls this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Bowls this one outside the off stump on a good length. Hrishita Basu knocks this towards cover.
Continues to bowl on a good length and in line with the stumps. Titas Sadhu gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
This is on a good length and outside the off pole. Titas Sadhu pushes at this but misses once again.
Sienna Ginger bowls this one short and wide outside off. Titas Sadhu goes hard at the ball but does not connect.
Goes back to tossing this one full and straight. Hrishita Basu gets her front foot forward and dabs this towards the bowler.
Bowls this one short and into the stumps. Titas Sadhu mistimes her shot towards long on and takes one.
Flights this one full and in line with the stumps. Titas Sadhu knocks this firmly back towards the bowler.
Tosses this one full and outside the off pole. Titas Sadhu digs this out towards mid off. @
Bowls this one slightly short and outside the off stump. Hrishita Basu slaps this towards cover and a misfield allows them to take a single.
Ella Hayward floats this one full and outside off. Hrishita Basu gets forward and pushes this towards cover-point.
On a length and on off, Hrishita Basu moves across and looks to ramp it, but miscues it towards third man for a run.
Full and on off, Titas Sadhu taps it towards backward point for a single.
Titas Sadhu is the new batter out in the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! India Women Under-19 lose their seventh wicket now! Sienna Ginger gets her third. She serves this full and outside off, Mannat Kashyap looks to slog it away, but fails to get the connection right and lobs it in the air towards mid off. Kate Pelle there settles under it and take a comfortable catch with fingers up. Australia Women Under-19 are way on top here.
Commentary.Howout: c Kate Pelle b Sienna Ginger

Commentary.Commentary: Short and outside off, Mannat Kashyap slaps it straight to extra covers.
Good-length delivery, on middle, Mannat Kashyap looks to work it away, but gets a leading edge towards covers.
This is on a hard length and on middle, Hrishita Basu pulls it towards wide of mid on for a single.
Short and on middle, Mannat Kashyap mistimes her pull towards the bowler.
A bit fuller and on off, Hrishita Basu looks to heave it away, but gets an inside edge onto her pads as the ball rolls towards point. They cross.
Short and way outside off, Hrishita Basu lets it go to the keeper. Wided.
Back of a length and outside off, Hrishita Basu slaps it towards covers.
Full and outside off, Mannat Kashyap slices it towards third man for a run.

Overthrows! This is full and on middle, Hrishita Basu tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a couple of steps forward. The fielder throws at the batter's end, but misses and there is no back up. The batters get a run.
Maggie Clark bowls this on a hard length, outside off, Hrishita Basu slashes at it, but misses.

A slower delivery bowled full and outside the off stump. Mannat Kashyap looks to swing through the line of the ball but gets beaten by the pace. End of another successful over for Australia Women Under-19.
Full and on off, Mannat Kashyap pushes it towards mid off.
Mannat Kashyap strides out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Sienna Ginger gets her second wicket! She lands this short and off, Parshavi Chopra looks to pull it away, but gets hurried a bit and mistimes it in the air wide of mid on. Claire Moore there runs to her left and takes a good catch sliding in. India Women Under-19 six down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Claire Moore b Sienna Ginger

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and outside off again, Parshavi Chopra misses her cut shot.
Fuller one and outside off, swinging away, Parshavi Chopra tries to reach for it, but fails to connect.
This is on a good length and around off, Hrishita Basu moves across and scoops it towards fine leg for a single.
Slightly shorter and on middle, Hrishita Basu moves back and forced it towards long on for one more.
Flighted, full and on middle, Parshavi Chopra eases it towards long on for a run.
Floats this one full and into the stumps. Hrishita Basu dabs this towards covers with soft hands and takes a quick single.
Short and on off, Hrishita Basu guides it towards point.
Floated, full and on off, Hrishita Basu drills it towards cover-point.
Tossed up, full and on off, Hrishita Basu drives it towards covers.

EDGED BUT DROPPED! Sienna Ginger serves this full and on off, Hrishita Basu looks to drive it away, but gets an outside edge towards the keeper where Paris Hall moves to her right, stretches her right hand but spills it out.
BEAUTY! This is on a good length and on off, holds its line a bit, Hrishita Basu looks to play at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Sienna Ginger bowls this on a hard length and outside off, Hrishita Basu leaves it alone.
Hrishita Basu makes her way out to the middle with her team in a spot of bother.

OUT! TAKEN! Shweta Sehrawat is gone! Sienna Ginger gets the most important wicket for Australia Women Under-19! She serves this full and around middle and leg, Shweta Sehrawat makes room to clear the in field, but mistimes it badly as the ball goes off the bottom half of the bat and flies towards mid on. Claire Moore there moves backwards and pouches it safely. Shweta Sehrawat is dismissed for the first time in this tournament and India Women Under-19 lose half their side now.
Commentary.Howout: c Claire Moore b Sienna Ginger

Commentary.Commentary: Full again and on off, Parshavi Chopra dabs it in front of point for a run.
Sienna Ginger begins with a full delivery, on middle, Shweta Sehrawat drills it towards mid on for a single.

Drinks! Australia Women Under-19 are right on top here. They came out with a plan and executed it to perfect agains the Indian batters. Their only threat now is Shweta Sehrawat who has been brilliant throughout the tournament. India Women Under-19 need a partnership now to rebuild their innings. On the other hand, Australia Women Under-19 will know that if they get a couple of wickets now, they could restrict their opponents to a low score. An excition second half of this innings awaits us. Sienna Ginger has been brought into the attack.
Loopy delivery this time in line with the stumps on a fuller length. Parshavi Chopra whips this towards the mid-wicket fielder.
Bowls this one slightly short and spinning into the stumps. Parshavi Chopra rocks back and clips this towards mid-wicket.
Tosses this one outside off on a fuller length. Shweta Sehrawat looks to paddle this but gets a top edge that goes over the keeper's head for a single.
Flights this one full and outside the off pole. Parshavi Chopra powers this down to long on for a single.
Goes fuller this time and outside the off stump. Parshavi Chopra knocks this hard back to the bowler.
Ella Hayward floats this one full and just outside off. Parshavi Chopra dabs this back towards the bowler.
We will see spin for the first time as Ella Hayward is ready to bowl now.
Goes full this time and on the pads. Parshavi Chopra clips this down to fine leg and collects a run.
Delivers this one back of a length and just outside the off stump. Parshavi Chopra blocks this back down the pitch towards the bowler.

EDGED AND FOUR! Parshavi Chopra is off the mark with a streaky boundary but India Women Under-19 will take all the runs! Rhys McKenna bowls this short and wide outside off. Parshavi Chopra swings her bat and gets an outside edge towards third man for four runs.
WIDE Strays down leg once again and on a good length. Parshavi Chopra gets inside the line of the ball to play it fine but misses and the umpire indicates that it is wide.
Bowls this one slightly short and angling down leg. Shweta Sehrawat pulls this towards deep backward square leg for a single.
This is on a good length as well and outside the off pole. Shweta Sehrawat dabs this towards cover and looks for a run that is not there.
Rhys McKenna bowls this on a good length and outside the off stump. Shweta Sehrawat goes hard at the ball but does not connect.
Goes slightly fuller this time and offers width outside off. Parshavi Chopra is tempted into the shot and is beaten all ends up.
Bowls this one slightly back of a length and outside the off stump. Parshavi Chopra leaves this one alone.
Parshavi Chopra gets promoted in the batting order and walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Another batter bites the dust and Maggie Clark has her second wicket! The dangerous Richa Ghosh has to make the long walk back to the shed. Maggie Clark continues to bowl on a good length and outside the off stump. Richa Ghosh looks to drive on the up and gets a slight edge to Paris Hall behind the wicket. There is a massive appeal from the wicket-keeper and the bowler and the umoires finger rises slowly. Richa Ghosh looks disappointed with herself and India Women Under-19 lose their fourth wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Paris Hall b Maggie Clark

Commentary.Commentary: Bowls this one on a good length as well but wide outside off. Richa Ghosh strokes this towards deep point for a couple of runs.

FOUR! Richa Ghosh gives the bowler the charge! Maggie Clark bowls this on a good length and in line with the stumps. Richa Ghosh shimmies down the wicket and knocks this over the bowler's head. Does not connect cleanly but the ball has enough legs to reach the rope.
Maggie Clark bowls this on a good length and angles this in from outside the off stump. Shweta Sehrawat guides this towards deep backward point for a single.
Bowls this one back of a length and outside the off stump. Richa Ghosh stands tall and punches this towards cover.

Slight Halt! Shweta Sehrawat looks to be in some pain after getting hit around her thighs on the previous delivery. The physio is in to check on her and applying the magic spray. We are good to go now.
Delivers this one slightly short and angling down leg. Shweta Sehrawat looks to pull this leg side but gets hit on her hips and the ball goes towards short fine leg as they take a leg bye.
Bowls this one full and outside the off stump. Shweta Sehrawat dabs this towards the point fielder.

FOUR! This has been swatted away! Rhys McKenna offers width outside the off stump on a fuller length. Shweta Sehrawat goes hard at the ball and gets the toes end of the bat at it. Gets enough power to get it over the infield towards deep cover-point for four runs.
Bowls this back of a length and outside the of stump. Shweta Sehrawat punches this towards point.
Rhys McKenna gets some swing early! Bowls this on a good length and outside the off stump. Shweta Sehrawat plays inside the line of the ball and gets beaten but some lateral movement.
Rhys McKenna replaces Lucy K Hamilton.
This is slightly short and outside the off stump. Shweta Sehrawat cuts this towards point and another misfield allows them to take a single.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Maggie Clark bowls this on a yorker length and into the pads. Shweta Sehrawat digs this out towards mid on and the fielder makes an absolute mess of it. The ball races away to the long on fence for four runs.
Goes full and outside the off stump. Richa Ghosh thumps this to the right of mid off and takes a quick single to get off the mark.
WIDE! Strays down leg stump this time on a fuller length. Richa Ghosh looks to clip this but misses and the umpire calls this one wide.
Delivers this one on a good length and just outside the off stump. Richa Ghosh blocks this solidly towards cover.
Bowls this one on a fuller length and outside the off pole. Richa Ghosh pushes at this one and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Richa Ghosh walks out to bat now with her side in a spot of bother.

OUT! TIMBER! Maggie Clark strikes on her very first delivery and India Women Under-19 have lost their third wicket inside the Powerplay! She bowls a slower delivery on a yorker length and in line with the stumps. Soniya Mendhiya plays all over the line of the ball and watches it creep through to shatter her stumps. India Women Under-19 are in a spot of bother here and are in desperate need of a partnership. Australia Women Under-19 are bossing the game here and could not have asked for a better start.
Maggie Clark comes into the attack now.
Swing and a miss! This is on a hard length and around off, Shweta Sehrawat makes room and swings through the line, but only connects with thin air.
Full again and on middle, Shweta Sehrawat works it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller one and on off, Shweta Sehrawat drives it towards extra covers.
On a length and on off, Soniya Mendhiya cuts it through backward point for a single.
A touch fuller and on off, Soniya Mendhiya mistimes her drive down the pitch.
Lucy K Hamilton serves this on a hard length and around off, Soniya Mendhiya looks to steer it towards point, but misses.
Short of a length and on off, Shweta Sehrawat punches it towards covers. There is a bit of hesitation between the batters, but no harm done.
Delivers a full toss this time outside the off pole. Soniya Mendhiya knocks this towards deep backward point for a single to open her account.
Bowls this one full and wide outside the off stump. Soniya Mendhiya reaches for it and gets beaten.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! An absolute stunner behind the stumps to dismiss Trisha! Milly Illingworth lands this short of a length and outside off, Gongadi Trisha slashes at it, but gets an outside edge towards the keeper where Paris Hall shwos quick refelxes and dives to her right to take a one-handed stunner. She herself cannot believe it that she took the catch. India Women Under-19 in early trouble here.
Commentary.Howout: c Paris Hall b Milly Illingworth

Commentary.Commentary: Soniya Mendhiya is the new batter at the crease.
Milly Illingworth loses her line and bowls this way outside off, Gongadi Trisha leaves it alone. Wided.
Back of a length and on off, Shweta Sehrawat guides it towards third man for a run.

On a length and on middle, Gongadi Trisha nudges it towards mid-wicket and sets off for the run. The fielder collects and thorws at the bowler's end where Milly Illingworth breaks the stumps, but Trisha is safe.
Shweta Sehrawat is struggling here! This is another good-length delivery, on off, angling away, Shweta Sehrawat fails to make any contact.
Overpitched and on off, Gongadi Trisha drills it towards covers where the fielder makes a good stop. They cross.
Lucy K Hamilton bangs this short and on middle, Gongadi Trisha pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for brace.

On a length and down the leg side, Gongadi Trisha misses her flick as the ball goes through to the keeper. Australia Women Under-19 appeal for the caught behind, but it is turned down. It is called a wide.
Short and outside off, Shweta Sehrawat punches it uppishly but through point for a single.
Back of a length and outside off, Shweta Sehrawat looks to cut it away, but misses.
Full and on off, Shweta Sehrawat drives it towards mid off.
Gongadi Trisha makes her way out to the middle at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Milly Illingworth draws first blood! This is a huge, huge wicket for Australia Women Under-19 and they are absolutely delighted. Milly Illingworth lands this on a hard length, on off, Shafali Verma comes down the track to drive this on the up, but gets a bit cramped and miscues her shot in the air towards covers. Rhys McKenna there takes the catch. India Women Under-19 lose their first wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Rhys McKenna b Milly Illingworth

Commentary.Commentary: Sharp bouncer! Milly Illingworth bangs in a short delivery, on middle, Shafali Verma ducks under it.
FOUR! Up and over! This is full again and outiside off, Shafali Verma leans into this one and drills it over point for a boundary.
Goes fuller and on middle, Shafali Verma tucks it towards mid-wicket.
On a length and way outside off, Shafali Verma throws her bat at it, but fails to connect.

FOUR! Shafali Verma gets off the mark with a boundary! Milly Illingworth starts with a good-length delivery on off, Shafali Verma waits for it and guides it towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Milly Illingworth will share the attack and bowl from the other end.
Pulls her length back a bit, on off, Shweta Sehrawat slashes and misses one more time.
FOUR! Nice shot! Lucy K Hamilton serves this full and on off, Shweta Sehrawat stays there and threads it through covers for a boundary.
BEATEN AGAIN! Lucy K Hamilton bowls another good-length delivery, outside off, angling away, Shweta Sehrawat has a poke at it, but gets beaten on the outside edge.
This is on a good length and around off, angling away, Shweta Sehrawat looks to cut it, but misses.

India Women Under-19 are underway! This is full and around off, Shweta Sehrawat steers it through point where the third man fielder covers her ground and dives to her right to stop it. Two runs taken!
Good start from Lucy K Hamilton! She begins with a pin-point yorker, on middle, Shweta Sehrawat digs it out towards point.

We are done with the pre-match formalities as the umpires go out to the middle. The Australia Women Under-19 players disperse on the field and take their respective fielding positions. Shafali Verma and Shweta Sehrawat will resume their partnership at the top of the order and will open the inning of India Women Under-19. Lucy K Hamilton has been handed the new ball and will begin proceedings. Let's play...

We are moments away from the start of the game but first, the players of both teams will line up for their respective national anthems. It will be Australia's national anthem first followed by the national anthem of India.

Pitch Report - Julia Price is pitchside to give us information about the conditions. She says it is a hot day and it will be the second game played on the same pitch. Mentions that there was a little bit of turn on offer and there are a few cracks which may not play a massive part. Adds that there is a little bit of grass and should help grip the ball in the wicket. Claims that there should be some uneven bounce which could get the pace bowlers into play but it is a dry pitch. Reckons that it will be an interesting game in which 130-140 could be a par score.

Shafali Verma the captain of India Women Under-19 says they wanted to bat first. Informs that they gave one change as Parshavi Chopra comes in for Yashasri. Mentions that it is important to get runs for the team and she hopes to continue playing the same way.

Rhys McKenna the skipper of Australia Women Under-19 says that they will have a bowl first. Adds that the wicket looks fair and they want to chase a target. Mentions that it is a big deal to make it to the Super Six stage. Tells that they have a good bowling attack to counter the Indian batters. Informs they have made one change.

Australia Women Under-19 (Playing XI) - Kate Pelle, Sienna Ginger, Claire Moore, Ella Hayward, Amy Smith, Lucy K Hamilton, Rhys McKenna (C), Paris Hall (WK) (In place of Charis Bekker), Ella Wilson, Milly Illingworth, Maggie Clark.

India Women Under-19 (Playing XI) - Shweta Sehrawat, Shafali Verma (C), Gongadi Trisha, Richa Ghosh (WK), Soniya Mendhiya, Hrishita Basu, Titas Sadhu, Archana Devi, Mannat Kashyap, Parshavi Chopra (In place of Yashasri), Sonam Yadav.
TOSS - The captains are out in the middle. The coin is flipped into the air and lands in favor of Australia Women Under-19. They have elected to BOWL first.

Australia Women Under-19 on the other hand suffered a shocking defeat in their first game against Bangladesh Women Under-19, but have recovered well and put in strong performances in the next two games. They are coming here as runner's up of Group A, but playing against India Women Under-19 will motivate them massively to get one over them. They have a pretty decent bowling attack and will look to put pressure on their opponents early, but their main challenge will be to counter the incredibly good spin attack of the ladies from the subcontinent. It is going to be a game of nerves. Let's see who comes out on top. Stay tuned for toss and team news.

We have reached the Super Six stage in the inaugural ICC Under-19 Women’s T20 World Cup and this tournament has already given us a glimpse of some exciting cricket with some unpredictable results. We focus our attention on match number 3 of this stage as the winners of Group D India Women Under-19 lock horns against Australia Women Under-19 who are the runners-up of Group A at the North-West University No1 Ground in Potchefstroom, for a clash that many would have eagerly looked forward to. The two teams are part of Group 1 which includes the three teams that have qualified from Group A and Group D with the points being carried forward from the earlier stage. The points that were won against the fourth-placed team do not count so India Women Under-19 find themselves on top of the table on 4 points with a massive net run rate while Australia Women Under-19 have just 2 points in their kitty. They lost their opening game against Bangladesh Women Under-19 but won their remaining two games to proceed further in the tournament. The ladies from Down Under suffered an early injury blow which saw them lose Chloe Ainsworth and Jade Allen to thumb fractures and they were replaced by Paris Hall and Ananaya Sharma. They have gone with a strong squad in a bid to clinch this trophy and assert their dominance in Women’s cricket just as their seniors. They will be led by Rhys McKenna and have powerful batters like Kate Pelle, Claire Moore, and Ella Hayward at their disposal. They have ample bowling options which can be proven by the fact that 7 bowlers were used by them in the last game and each of them picked up at least one wicket. Maggie Clark looks dangerous with her pace bowling and they have the experience of Amy Smith in the spin department. They will have a tough encounter against an in-form India Women Under-19 side that has provided some fireworks with their big hitters Shafali Verma, Richa Ghosh, and Gongadi Trisha. However, the star for them so far has been their vice-captain Shweta Sehrawat who is the leading run-scorer of this competition with 197 runs and is yet to be dismissed. Shabnam MD and Titas Sadhu are handling the pace bowling duties with Mannat Kashyap and Parshavi Chopra proving to be quite a handful with their spin. This is a game Australia Women Under-19 need to win to boost their chances of making it to the semi-finals. Will they be able to achieve it? Or will India Women Under-19 continue their unbeaten run in this competition? We will find out soon.
